pages.title: What this extension does
pages.explains: Upload sends one file you explicitly select to a cloud destination you configure, only after destination approval. The file bytes and your API key stay in the trusted host; this guest only asks the host to act.
pages.changes: After installing, an 'API key…' action appears, and 'Upload selected file' once an API key is saved. The extension's settings say whether a key is saved and whether the destination accepts it; checking that sends the key to the destination and nothing else. An upload sends the selected file to a third-party destination where it may be publicly visible through a link; nothing is sent without your approval.
